method.expectedValues: The physical-tab and conversation ledger below is the oracle. Product reducer, metadata reader, recovery status and opaque identifiers may be observed, but never generate expected results.
method.automationWindow: After faults are released, advance only the independent clock and ordinary product alarms/page events. Do not invoke diagnostics, manual observe, retry, pairing, monitor toggles, reload or focus to make recovery succeed.
method.limits: A controlled API/DOM substitute is synthetic evidence only. Real Chrome lifecycle, actual provider DOM binding, Windows/macOS focus and Japanese IME remain unverified unless separately exercised in those environments.
method.positiveBinding: Do not invent a provider selector or a page attribute to make automatic approval pass. If a researched binding cannot be supplied, real-provider useful recovery is UNKNOWN; passing safe quarantine is insufficient. Any protocol-only positive control must be labelled separately.

steps: Start with valid saved pairing and no broken storage
Make the first tab query throw synchronously, reject, or remain pending beyond its deadline in separate runs
Release the enumeration fault
Permit ordinary automatic triggers only
expected: The pairing remains intact
The failure is not classified as storage_failed
No prior tab is treated as closed on an unknown tab list
A fresh observation is delivered within 45000 ms without a diagnostic or manual recovery request

steps: Start with a real failing storage boundary in separate local/session read and write runs
Request startup or submit an observation that needs that write
expected: The product fails closed
No success ACK is given for an undurable observation
No ready/connected success is asserted on failed mandatory initialization

steps: Start a tab enumeration while only desk-left exists
Introduce desk-right and durably record a new observation before the old query resolves
Resolve the old query without desk-right
expected: desk-right remains current
Its route, notification set and focus target are unchanged
A stale enumeration cannot fabricate a close event

steps: Create an unread notification R1 for A
Observe a later generation in A
Invalidate its observer
Change only the route to B and expose B's navigation title while central submitted text and generation controls still belong to A
Start a new observer with no old storage.session route history
Keep A's central DOM stable past 100 ms, 2000 ms and 10000 ms, including a new-node copy
Replace the central region with B's existing idle screen
expected: At no point is ALPHA_SUBMITTED_1 recorded under B
At no point is A's running or terminal event recorded under B
No new B notification is created from the existing idle screen
R1 is retained
Neither private draft token reaches persisted browser metadata or diagnostics
A title proven by B's exact navigation link may be separate from unproven central content

steps: While the current observer has route B but central DOM A, request ordinary health, immediate observation, visibility and pageshow through separate trials
Attempt focus-and-ACK for B using the current observer identity
expected: No alternate entry bypasses quarantine
Focus success is denied while conversation binding is unproven
The captured unread set is unchanged even if the physical tab was activated

steps: Hold an injection until after its timeout
Pause or unpair before allowing the old injection to run
Release delayed page work and messages
expected: The expired attempt creates no accepted metadata, generation or terminal event
No state is written back after successful unpair
Already saved desktop unread notifications are retained

steps: Deliver a generation-stop event R1 for one physical tab
Start another generation
Deliver its distinct stop event R2
Replay R2
expected: After the new start the unread set is exactly {R1}
After the new stop the unread set is exactly {R1,R2}
After replay the unread set is still exactly {R1,R2}

steps: Start focus while R1 is the only unread notification and hold focus completion
Deliver R2 during focus
Complete focus to the verified requested physical tab and conversation
expected: The click captures only R1
After successful focus the unread set is exactly {R2}
If final focus validation fails the unread set is exactly {R1,R2}

steps: Use independently researched real-provider binding evidence for B
Recover without diagnostics
Submit BETA_SUBMITTED_1
Observe generation and then stop
Focus the corresponding row
expected: Within the fixed deadlines B's title, latest submission, status and physical focus destination agree
Exactly one notification belongs to the new B stop
An implementation returning permanent unknown or blank metadata fails useful recovery
Without provider evidence this case is UNKNOWN, never promoted from a safe-quarantine pass

mutationRequirements: A query-to-storage_failed mutation must fail I-A1 on misclassification or loss of automatic recovery, not startup syntax errors.
A bypass of storage failure must fail I-A2 on an improper ready/ACK result.
Removing automatic triggers while retaining manual recovery must fail diagnostic-free recovery.
Removing the binding gate or using time alone must fail I-B1 on wrong conversation data or generation.
Acknowledging all unread notifications after focus must fail I-U13 because R2 disappears.
Each mutation must activate, and its unchanged control must pass the same executable case.
